hero.body: Natural crystal jewelry, shaped slowly by hand on a quiet shoreline of New Zealand.

philosophy.label: Philosophy
philosophy.title: A house built on stillness and stone.

natural.title: Natural Materials
natural.body: We work only with natural stones — preserving their original texture, inclusions, and quiet energy.

timeless.title: Timeless Aesthetics
timeless.body: We reject the speed of trends. Each piece is designed to transcend the year it was born in.

quality.title: Quality First
quality.body: From the choice of stone to the final hand-finished detail — every step is held to what a piece worth keeping for a lifetime demands.

collections.title: Chapters from one shoreline.
collections.intro: Each collection is shaped by a different hour of the coast — its weather, its colour, its quiet.

featured.subtitle: From the Last Queen collection
featured.title: Last Queen No.03
featured.body: For the woman who has been remade by what she's lived through — and returned to herself, softer and more her own.
featured.stoneBody: Hand-selected rainbow moonstone, chosen for its rare adularescence — a slow shift of silver-blue light that surfaces only at certain angles. Historically worn across cultures as a quiet companion through transformation: from one self into the next.
featured.materialBody: Hand-forged at our New Zealand studio, made one at a time. No two are truly alike — every Last Queen No.03 carries the small, deliberate signatures of the hands that shaped it.
featured.stylingBody: Worn alone against the collarbone in the morning, layered with finer chains for evening — not to perform, but to accompany. Left to rest on linen when not in wear.

journal.title: Notes on the stones we choose to keep.
journal.intro: Considered, unhurried writing on the materials that shape our work — their history, their character, the way they live with the wearer.

about.title: Founded in 2019, on a quiet New Zealand shore.
about.p1: SIREN TEARS began in 2019 on the coast of New Zealand — the kind of shoreline where the light arrives slowly, the weather is something you read like a page, and a piece of jewelry can take all the time it needs.
about.p2: Every piece is hand-shaped. We work only with natural stones that arrive as themselves — preserved texture, original character, the quiet authority of something not made to be rushed.
about.p3: Six years on, our pieces are worn by a community of women across more than thirty-five countries — women returning to themselves, keeping what matters, passing it on.

footer.tagline: Natural crystal jewelry, made slowly by the southern sea.
footer.crafted: Crafted slowly, by the southern sea.
